scope: UR3: MSBuild, CMake, Ninja, vswhere and the Windows SDK tools resolve and run in the signed-in user's environment and as that user; talvora_vs_dev_environment stays with the service

libraries.verified: 2026-11-08 UR3: vswhere.exe lists every Visual Studio instance as JSON and ships with Visual Studio 2017 and later in C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer, a machine-wide folder, so the signed-in user runs it and the MSBuild it finds the same way the service did; the user's own PATH and variables now decide which cmake, ninja and SDK tools are found. Query: vswhere; vswhere find MSBuild location.
